name: Udaipur
tagline: Royal palace conclaves & lakeside executive networking
intro: Heritage palace hotels and lakeside luxury properties for high-impact annual board meets, partner summits, and royal galas.
access: Direct flights from Delhi, a little over an hour.
highlights: Lake-facing properties and courtyard venues suit leadership retreats and top-performer trips where the setting is part of the reward.
Compact enough that a two-night programme does not lose half a day to travel between venues.
Reads as a premium destination without an international air fare or a visa.
planning_note: Wedding season from November to February competes directly for the best venues. Hold dates early or shift to September and October.
